title: A set of declarations to apply
description: What PUT /api/v1/declarations reads, and what `ingestion connectors apply` sends from a directory: every connector, routing rule and destination, applied whole under the commit they came from.

commit.description: The commit the set came from, as the declarations row records it.

replaces.description: The commit the caller saw in force, and null where it saw no set. Where another commit is in force, the service refuses the apply with 409 declarations_moved, unless this commit is the one in force already.
